title: Maná de cada ánima en combate

steps.eval: navigator.getGamepads = () => []; window.fightReady = () => document.querySelector('#hud[data-battle]') && window.gerard.battleUI.fight?.phase === 'player' && !window.gerard.battleUI.fight.busy && document.activeElement?.matches('.command-trigger'); window.turnOf = id => window.fightReady() && document.querySelector('.battle-dock[data-dock="1"]')?.dataset.member === id; { const set = window.gerard.game.setBattle; window.gerard.game.setBattle = (state, ...rest) => { window.fightState = state; return set(state, ...rest); }; }

steps.caption: Full: three circles beside each ánima
Yuki se esconde spent one of Papagato's; Matemágico, resting, keeps its three

steps.eval: { const g = window.fightState.allies.find(a => a.id === 'gerard'); window.fightState.allies.forEach(a => { a.maxSecondary = 6; }); g.secondary = 4; g.mana = { matemagico: 5 }; window.gerard.battleUI.refresh(); }

steps.caption: With six maná (the future): two rows of three

description: In a fight each pill of the ánima bar (src/battle-ui.ts chipMana) shows that ánima's maná as little circles in its colour: the worn one spends it, the others keep theirs and get some back resting. Three to a row, so up to six fit in two.
